title: The Unicorn Way gate opens for the wizard whose quest goal opens it, and for nobody else, and stays open after a relog and a zone change
notes: 10.03: two fresh wizards enter the Commons and the main account is a game master. Each is stood before WC_GateCommons_ToUnicornWay and sees it closed.
The game master types .quest add WC-MAIN-C01-003 and .quest goal WC-MAIN-C01-003 WC-MAIN-C01-003_Goal0; the goal posts GoalComplete_WC-MAIN-C01-003_WC-MAIN-C01-003_Goal0,
OpenGateToUW fires and its ResAddDynaMod gives the wizard the gate's Dynamod in IdleOpen, which the server tells the client with MSG_DYNAMODBEHAVIOR_UPDATEMODS and MSG_ENTERSTATE IdleOpen.

The gate swings open, its bars rising for about a second, and rests IdleOpen: the shot 0.3 seconds after the goal must differ from the closed gate and from the raised one, which a gate that snapped open would match.
The companion still sees the gate closed. The game master relogs and travels to Ravenwood and back, and each time sees the gate open.
The driver's world has no WC-MAIN-C01-003 template, so the relog prunes the quest and says so; the gate's mod stays.
